statement: Paying the invoice is not safe and correct because the payment history indicates invoice 88412 was already paid in full on 3 September under reference PAY-2291.
judge_text:
WRONG

"Paying the invoice is not safe and correct because the payment history indicates invoice 88412 was already paid in full" — asserts the unpaid status is contradicted and paying would be a duplicate.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
